equation_entries.relation_or_code_path: impact -> R_gen -> Psi_carrier -> detector interaction -> effect -> R_obs

variables.impact: physical interaction with declared mass, energy, momentum, field, or stress-energy coupling
variables.Psi_carrier: physical signal carrier; identity is lane-specific
variables.effect: receiver-side input-output influence or record update

equation_entries.mathematical_role: separation of physical coupling, propagation, and observer-side information effect
equation_entries.standard_physics_counterpart: field-mediated interaction, signal propagation, detector response, and information as a state/correlation relation

observable_mapping.proxy: source transition, carrier spectrum/energy/arrival, detector response, and receiver record
observable_mapping.reason: carrier-specific detector and dimensional unit lanes are not closed

equation_entries.source_or_origin: ontology refinement from the observation-delay and matter-to-carrier thought experiments
assumptions: impact and effect are different layers
effect does not require source-mass transfer
physical receiver change requires a causal carrier and detector interaction
mass-bearing phase can terminate while energy-momentum and trace continue in products
equation_entries.symmetry_and_conservation: carrier lane must preserve declared energy-momentum and relevant charge/current conservation
limiting_cases: no carrier or detector interaction gives no observer effect
same carrier can produce different records under different detector maps
electron-positron annihilation is a standard reaction comparator, not a universal UET law
equation_entries.proof_status: ontology candidate; carrier derivation, units, and observable mapping open
equation_entries.claim_boundary: candidate impact/effect ontology; no universal photon, neutrino, positron, or massless-transition identity established
equation_entries.failure_mode: effect is treated as a nonphysical force, information is treated as a new substance, or a particle lane is promoted without source and detector mapping
equation_entries.next_hardening_step: build a no-fit carrier-neutral comparator for photon, neutrino, and matter-antimatter reaction lanes
